$comment: Curated task intents for the Atlas command palette (public/atlas.js). An intent answers a goal with ordered steps instead of a single link, because the hard part of this product is knowing which of several plausible pages STARTS a flow. Every `to` is validated against data/pages.json by scripts/build-atlas-index.mjs; a step pointing at a route that does not exist fails the build. Keep `match` phrases in the words a newcomer would actually type, not our internal feature names.

intents.title: I am new here. Where do I start?
intents.blurb: The shortest path from nothing to a live 3D agent on your own page.

steps.do: Walk the guided setup. It asks three questions and creates your first agent.
Give it a body: describe the avatar you want and generate it.
Put it on a page. Widget Studio writes the embed code for you.

intents.title: Make a 3D avatar
intents.blurb: Text to a rigged, animation-ready GLB.

steps.do: Describe the avatar you want. The forge returns a rigged GLB.
Pose and animate it in the Animation Studio.
Browse what others made if you would rather start from an existing one.

intents.title: Turn a photo into a 3D avatar
intents.blurb: A selfie or a product photo becomes a textured 3D model.

steps.do: Use Selfie to Avatar for a person.
Use Image to 3D for an object or a product shot.
Need the highest fidelity? Forge Max runs the slow, high-quality lane.

intents.title: Put an avatar on my website
intents.blurb: One script tag and one custom element. Works in plain HTML, React, and Next.js.

steps.do: Build the widget visually and copy the generated snippet.
Follow the 30-second version if you just want the two lines.
Framework-specific setup for React and Next.js.

intents.title: Create an AI agent
intents.blurb: An agent with a body, a mind, a wallet, and an on-chain identity.

steps.do: Create the agent and give it a name, a personality, and a model.
Tune its behaviour, tools, and voice in Agent Studio.
Manage everything you own from My Agents.

intents.title: Launch a coin
intents.blurb: Mint a token for your agent on pump.fun, from the platform.

steps.do: Launch the coin. Name, ticker, image, and the initial buy.
Read what each field does before you sign anything.
Watch it land in the platform launch feed.

intents.title: Get paid per API call
intents.blurb: Meter any endpoint with x402 and let other agents pay to use it.

steps.do: Wire the paywall in x402 Studio.
Follow the worked example of a paid endpoint end to end.

intents.title: Pay another agent for a service
intents.blurb: Discover a paid endpoint and settle the call in USDC.

steps.do: Browse every paid endpoint the network exposes.
Follow the discover-and-pay walkthrough.
Fund the wallet your agent pays from.

intents.title: Connect this to Claude or another MCP client
intents.blurb: Give your assistant 3D generation, wallets, and market intel as tools.

steps.do: Browse every tool the MCP servers expose.
Copy the client config for your assistant.
Start with the free 3D Studio server if you want zero setup.

intents.title: Animate or pose an avatar
intents.blurb: Clips, gestures, and mocap on any humanoid rig.

steps.do: Pose and preview clips on your own model.
Browse the clip library and copy the one you want.
Map gestures to your agent's reactions.

intents.title: Make my avatar talk
intents.blurb: Lip-synced speech, a voice, and an exportable video.

steps.do: Pick or clone a voice in the Voice Lab.
Render a lip-synced talking video from a script.
Drive the same avatar live from your webcam.

intents.title: List or sell an agent
intents.blurb: Publish to the marketplace and let others fork or buy it.

steps.do: See what sells and how listings are presented.
Publish from the agent you own.
Check demand before you price it.

intents.title: Sign in or manage my account
intents.blurb: Email, wallet, billing, credits, and API keys.

steps.do: Sign in with email or a Solana wallet.
No account yet? Create one.
Keys, billing, and usage live in the dashboard.

intents.title: Is something broken?
intents.blurb: Live uptime, 90 days of history, and a machine-readable feed.

steps.do: Check live status and 90-day uptime for every surface.
Poll the same data as JSON from your own monitor.
Still stuck? The docs index is the fastest way to the right page.

intents.title: Show me everything
intents.blurb: The full route map: every page on three.ws, grouped and searchable.

steps.do: Browse the whole platform as one map.
Prefer a flat list? The sitemap has every route.
Reading as a machine? Take llms.txt instead.
